verified_facts.text: The Harbor View Hotel is in Edgartown, on Martha's Vineyard, about 7 miles off the coast of Massachusetts.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Harbor View Hotel located in Edgartown, on Martha’s Vineyard, captures the essence of the Great American Summer. Situated just 7 miles off the coast of Massachusetts

verified_facts.text: The hotel overlooks Edgartown Lighthouse, Edgartown Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Holding court over Edgartown Lighthouse, the Harbor and the Atlantic Ocean, the Harbor View Hotel offers stunning views

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from Fuller and Lighthouse Beaches, shopping in Edgartown Village and the natural habitat of Chappaquiddick Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: steps away from Fuller and Lighthouse Beaches, shopping in Edgartown Village and the natural habitat of Chappaquiddick Island.

verified_facts.text: In 1975 Steven Spielberg and the cast and crew of Jaws stayed on an entire floor of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: a young director by the name of Steven Spielberg and the cast and crew of “Jaws” resided on an entire floor at the hotel in 1975.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was restored and redesigned in 2019.
verified_facts.excerpt: Faithfully restored. Beautifully redesigned. Proudly reimagined in 2019.

verified_facts.text: A renovation revamped all the guest rooms in The Historic Building and The Roxana, along with new restaurants, landscaping, gardens and a heated saltwater pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: all of the guest rooms in The Historic Building and The Roxana have been revamped. All new restaurants offer divine and delicious dining options. Gorgeously designed landscaping, gardens and a heated, saltwater pool dazzle.

verified_facts.text: Guests choose between three building types: the grand historic building, The Roxana and the Captain's Cottages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose between three high end, bespoke resort building types. There’s the legendary grand historic building (don’t be surprised to spot a celebrity); The Roxana

verified_facts.text: The Roxana is named after owner Bernard Chiu's daughter, and its balconies overlook the pool scene and Edgartown Village.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Roxana, named after the owner Bernard Chiu’s daughter, exudes the contemporary, playful air of The Vineyard, complemented by luxury linens, glass sliding shower doors and pops of sunrise red. Balcony vistas overlook the lively pool scene and Edgartown Village.

verified_facts.text: The Captain's Cottages are stand-alone Victorian homes with one to three bedrooms, kitchenettes and living rooms, set along a blossom-filled walkway.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sprinkled along a blossom-filled walkway, the Captain’s Cottages exude an individual charm fit for a fairytale. Varying floor plans offer many options including outdoor showers. Ranging from one to three bedrooms with kitchenettes and living rooms

verified_facts.text: Some Captain's Cottages floor plans include outdoor showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Varying floor plans offer many options including outdoor showers.

verified_facts.text: The fourth-floor Presidential Skyhouse Wing looks over the Atlantic Ocean, Edgartown Harbor, Edgartown Lighthouse and Chappaquiddick Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soaring over the Atlantic Ocean, Edgartown Harbor, Edgartown Lighthouse and Chappaquiddick Island, the fourth floor Presidential Skyhouse Wing

verified_facts.text: Every room has Frette linens, a Nespresso coffee machine, robes, WiFi and wireless speakers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Harbor View Hotel room offers luxe bath products, Frette linens, Nespresso Coffee machines, luxe robes, WiFi, and wireless speakers.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated, saltwater outdoor pool, a fitness center and bicycles for guest use.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy the heated, saltwater, outdoor pool, fitness center, beautiful outdoor spaces, spectacular ocean views, close vicinity to town, and bicycles for guest use.

verified_facts.text: Bettini Restaurant serves contemporary American cuisine with expansive windows onto the coastal view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bettini, an upscale, fine-dining restaurant offering refined contemporary American cuisine and a fabulous selection of wine. The vibe is coastal chic with an elegant bar that draws a vibrant crowd of locals and island guests. Expansive windows reveal a magnificent coastal view

verified_facts.text: Roxy Pool Bar is set right by the pool and a landscaped garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set right by the pool and a dazzling landscaped garden, let the relaxation begin with a flute of champagne and a warm lobster roll.

verified_facts.text: Behind The View has harbor views and access to an outdoor veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: With harbor views and access to an outdoor veranda, the restaurant captures the waterfront charm of Harbor View Hotel.

verified_facts.text: Couples say their vows on the hotel's Great Lawn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Couples say vows on our Great Lawn.

verified_facts.text: The Lighthouse Path to the Edgartown Light is one of Martha's Vineyard's most walked paths.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lighthouse Path to the Edgartown Light is one of Martha's Vineyard's most walked paths and one of the main points of interest for visitors today.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Veranda overlooks Edgartown Harbor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Veranda Overlooking Edgartown Harbor

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2017, 2018, 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026.
The Harbor View Hotel opened in July 1891.
